description.text: Duration: two and a half to three years, both full-time and in-service study are acceptable. Time for Admission Application: Before June 30th Qualifications for Application: 1. All kinds of overseas people, including foreigners and overseas Chinese in Hongkong, Macao, Taiwan and foreign countries. 2. People with undergraduate diplomas or those graduating from a junior college more than 2 years ago Notes: Overseas Chinese should take the National Entrance Examination of every April; Foreigners can enroll without taking exams and should learn Chinese for one year in case of their poor Chinese language skills. Documents Needed: A photocopy of the passport A photocopy of College Graduation Certificate A photocopy of college report card Recommendation Letters from two professors (at least one of them should be full professor) 1-2 academic theses Two-inch color photo without hat

duration.text: The Chinese Culture and Communication at Xiamen University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6.1-2 academic theses
